'Warum sich das geändert hat' in my report: '8 × 5,35 € pro Angebot − 16,19 € pro Tag zu decken' (try-report.txt:223). I entered no staff and no advertising, so I could not tell what the 16,19 € is. It is my regulars switching: 11,4 a day × 1,42 €. The demo's '36,57 € pro Tag zu decken' (report.txt:306) has the same gap. Name the parts in the line itself: '− 16,19 € pro Tag, die wechselnde Stammgäste kosten (11,4 × 1,42 €)' and '− 36,57 € pro Tag (Personal 18,00 €, Werbung 5,00 €, wechselnde Stammgäste 13,57 €)'. Criterion: she can redo every sum with a calculator. It worked when every 'zu decken' amount on the page lists what it is made of.

Check page (try-phone.txt:349-351): just after I typed 3,60 € for ingredients, it says 'Anteil des Preises für Zutaten und Verpackung – What-IF nimmt 30 %'. I thought I had already answered that. It means my usual 11,20 € lunch, not the deal. Write 'Zutatenanteil Ihres normalen Mittagessens (11,20 €): What-IF nimmt 30 % = 3,36 €', and ask it as an optional second field on Frage 6. Criterion: knowing what is mine, what is assumed and what is a fact. It worked when no 'angenommen' row names something she has already answered.

Two numbers, said everywhere. The landing tile is headed 'Ihre Gewinnschwelle: zwei Zahlen' but shows only 'Gewinnschwelle 11 pro Tag' (landing.txt:138-143). The short-answer card asks only for the 11 (report.txt:82-84). After the guess, show both in the card ('Holt den Test herein: 11 · Trägt sich, zum Behalten: 7'), and put both lines in the landing tile. Criterion: owner understanding. It worked when every place that says 'zwei Zahlen' shows two numbers, and the first card names the 7.

Who plays the guests, said truthfully. The landing says 'Erzählen Sie dem Coach, was Sie gezählt haben' (landing.txt:165) and 'Mit Ihrem KI-Coach' (landing.txt:215). My report says 'Mit einem KI-Coach spielt eine KI' (try-report.txt:238). I have no coach. Write 'Ihre KI-App'. 'Denselben Probelauf ansehen, von Claude (KI) gespielt' (landing.txt:217) leads to Noor, Chiara, Paweł, Murat, Greta and Jan (report-ai.txt:310-370). The demo with fixed rules has Thanh, Fatima, Sofia, Leyla, Murat and Noor (report.txt:370-441). Either use the same six people, or write 'Ein Probelauf mit Claude (KI): dasselbe Angebot, andere ausgedachte Gäste'. 'In ihren Worten: 4 Zitate, 23 Fragen an Sie' (report-ai.txt:414) is too many questions to take to my counter; show the 3 to 5 best. Criterion: honesty about what the AI did. It worked when no German owner page says 'Coach', and the AI demo either shows the same cast or says that it does not.
understood: Break-even in the demo: 11 more lunch guests every weekday for the 10-day test to pay back the 180 € sign. 7 a day is enough to keep the deal, because the sign is paid either way. At 7 it brings only about 19 € a month (report.txt:558, 575).

My own report (the numbers from the phone run, Frage 9 left empty): with no sign and no extra staff, 4 a day is enough for both. The only cost is regulars switching, 16,19 € a day. Worst case −162 € if nobody new comes and 3 in 10 of my regulars switch, up to −540 € if all of them switch (try-report.txt:174-178).
The most the demo test could cost: −546 €, 36 % of the 1.500 € I can spare (report.txt:242-249).
The guess that matters most is how many extra guests come: 3 or 15 a day changes the result by 642 € (report.txt:530). That is what I count.

VAT is not mine: of 9,90 €, 8,95 € stays after 10,6 % VAT, and 5,35 € after 3,60 € of ingredients. The 10,6 % is the 7 %/19 % law with a 70/30 split that the BMF accepts for combined offers (try-phone.txt:368). Only my Steuerberater can tell me my real split.

After the test (report-result.txt): 6 extra a day, so the card says 'Anpassen'. The test ended at −184 € against −118 € expected. Only 21 % of regulars switched, not 30 %. Next time I start my guess at 6.
The rehearsal in my own report was played by fixed rules, not an AI: 2 of 6 noticed, 1 tried, nobody told anyone (try-rehearsal.txt). It is never scaled up, and my sums stay at my 8 a day.

wouldTry: yes, because the card tells me what to count, when to keep it (7 a day), when to adjust (4 to under 7) and when to stop (under 4 by day 5), and the receipts envelope keeps my cash in sight. I would fill Frage 9 myself (a 180 € sign, 1 hour at 18 €, 1.500 € spare). If I had tapped 'Weiter' there between customers, my report would have shown a profit with no sign in it, and I would only have noticed on the long check page.
learnedAboutAI: Plain code did every sum ('21 Ergebnisse kamen von einfachem Code', try-report.txt:289), and I redid them by hand. The extra guests and the switching regulars are guesses that only my test can answer. The other numbers What-IF filled in, I have to check myself: 'kein Test tut das' (try-report.txt:291). The imagined guests are good for questions and never a count. In my report they were played by fixed rules, and in the Claude demo by an AI, which told a different story ('Wer die Gäste spielt, verändert die Geschichte', landing.txt:219). That taught me more than any sentence could: imagined reactions depend on who imagines them. Next time an AI gives me a number, I ask: mine, calculated, guessed or imagined?
germanFirst: It reads like a person wrote it for me: 'Sie', short sentences, 'Z-Bon', 'Durchschnittsbon', 'Strichliste', 'Umschlag mit den Belegen'. 'Gewinnschwelle' is used everywhere, with 'Break-even' once in brackets (report.txt:259). All numbers are in German format ('9,90 €', '1.500 €', '−546 €', '36 %', '10,6 %'). The interview now sounds natural ('Thanh schwärmt davon', 'Wenn ich vor halb drei fertig bin'). Small slips: 'Thanh zu Fatima: „Probiert das Mittagsangebot …“' is the ihr form for one person, it should be 'Probier mal …' (landing.txt:194). 'falschzuliegen' and 'falsch zu liegen' are both used. 'ein zusätzliches Paar Hände' is still in the Step 2 details. 'fragen Sie uns nach einem neuen' (try-beta-wrong-code.png) does not say who 'uns' is.
